programmes.d: Bernie frets that he'll catch a debilitating bug from one of the pint-sized revelers at Bryana's birthday party.
Bernie teaches his nephew Jordan how to fight back against bullies that come with an unforeseen consequence.
When Wanda schedules a play date for the children, Bernie delights in playing host to a circle of admiring women.
After taking the children to church, Bernie tries to slip out during the sermon to catch a football game on the tube.
Bernie learns the kids are staying long-term and sets ground rules.
When Bryanna brings home a stray dog, the children hide it until Christmas Day, figuring Bernie will allow them to keep it.

Bernie is overwhelmed by the task of getting the children ready for their first day of school; Jordan pretends to be sick, Vanessa refuses to come out of the bathroom and Bryana wants to have her hair braided.
The pool is being drained, and the air conditioner is broken; Bernie takes the children to a water park on the hottest day of the year.
Wanda gets a week of vacation and decides to spend it with the kids.
Bernie tries to show the children who is the king of the castle after he realizes everything he says to them goes through Vanessa first.

Though married to a terrible shrew, a man (Eddie Murphy) tries to figure out a way to be with his childhood sweetheart (Thandie Newton), who has just moved back into town.

Greg impresses Chef Williams with his newfound passion for the culinary arts; Omar visits Naomi at her job unannounced; Keith receives an unexpected letter while Jarvis gets caught in the middle of a family confrontation.

Greg mentors a teenager through Big Brothers Big Sisters of America while Jarvis and Freddie Sr. play a card game; the group organizes an intervention for Omar, and Samoht performs as the musical guest.
Omar, Greg, Keith and Jarvis Johnson have a guys' night out that doesn't go exactly as planned; they run into popular radio host Eugene Johnson.
Lisa forces Jarvis to have a dinner date with their friends, Kevin and Karen; Omar, Greg and Keith hang out at a lounge where musical artist Emi Seacrest performs.
In 1974 Irish cop Bill Coughlin contends with fierce social pressure and rampant bigotry when he's assigned to protect Black students being bused into the all-white South Boston High School.
A detective (Morgan Freeman) and a Secret Service agent (Monica Potter) investigate the abduction of a senator's daughter from a school.
Omar, Greg and Jarvis attend Eugene Johnson's annual poker tournament; Keith goes salsa dancing with Bianca as he tries to figure out if it's a real date or not.
Omar learns the importance of mental health; Keith begins his search for a rental space for his dream photo gallery.
Bianca spends the night at Keith's loft leading him to believe that they can be more than friends; Omar visits his son, Caleb, and his estranged wife, Naomi.
Tensions rise during a pick-up basketball game as Jarvis and Greg's disagreements come to a head; Greg encounters the infamous Atlanta Water Boys when his car is broken into.

A woman finds herself in big trouble when a cartel leader forces her to do his dirty work to save her kidnapped friend. Determined to get away, she must now play a dangerous game to outwit the gang -- and the DEA agents who suspect her of complicity.
When his parents go out of town, DJ rents a room out to an elderly party animal; Hobbs and the Lieutenant pretend to be in a relationship when she tries to outshine her recently-engaged sister.

Poppa Bo comes to visit and teaches Tasha to fight, getting her into trouble at school and home; when Daniel accidentally leaks private information to the whole police precinct, the Lieutenant comes under fire.
The Manns give Terri money for her winning business idea, but her management style is less successful; a young man shows up at the precinct, claiming to be Hobbs' son.
The family plays into Daniel's health hysteria in order to get him to visit his doctor. Lieutenant Tate and Hobbs use a social media expert to help them solve a string of thefts.
Struggling to solve a tough case, an exhausted Daniel falls asleep and wakes up in a 70s blaxploitation cop show.
Daniel and Toni return home from their honeymoon to their new life, including their blended family and Daniel's mother, all under one roof.

programmes.t: In the Heat of the Night
programmes.d: Chief Gillespie refuses to point out the obvious suspect in the murder of Councilwoman DeLong's sister.
